snippet.title: Honey or Else - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Honey or Else is coming soon to Steam!
Wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5189980?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=channel
Our website: https://katanaprotocol.com/

Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.
